Its 'Record release manifest' job, however, ran its registry_state snapshot mid-publish, before npm:@redact-secret/node-linux-x64-gnu, npm:@redact-secret/node-win32-arm64-msvc, npm:@redact-secret/node-win32-x64-msvc had propagated on the npm registry, and recorded them 'unpublished' at that instant even though the same run's own later 'Verify registry install' jobs for those exact targets subsequently passed.
